Topic.label: Surface Area of a Rectangular Prism

Question:
A cube has an edge length of 2 centimeters. What is the area of one face in square centimeters? Calculate: \(2\times2=?\)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p161_q3_question_en.svg)
Solution: \(2\times2=4\), and the total area of the six faces is 24.
